en: The second of two things mentioned; or nearer to the end; or recent.
ex: Of the two choices, I prefer the latter.
兩個選擇中，我比較喜歡後者。

en: The system of rules of a country that people must obey; or a rule; or the study of these rules.
ex: It is against the law to drive without a license.
無照駕駛是違法的。

en: To put something down carefully on a surface; or (of a hen) to produce an egg; or past tense of 'lie'.
ex: She laid the baby gently in the crib.
她輕輕把寶寶放進嬰兒床。

en: The ability to lead a group of people; or the people who lead an organization.
ex: The team succeeded because of her strong leadership.
這個團隊因為她強大的領導力而成功。

en: A flat, green part of a plant that grows from a stem or branch; or a page of a book; or a thin sheet of material.
ex: The leaves turn yellow and red in autumn.
樹葉在秋天變成黃色和紅色。

en: Allowed by the law; or relating to the law.
ex: It is legal to vote at the age of eighteen.
十八歲就可以合法投票。

en: To give someone something for a short time, expecting it to be returned; or to give money to someone for them to pay back.
ex: Could you lend me your pen for a moment?
你可以借我你的筆一下嗎？

en: The measurement of something from one end to the other; or the amount of time that something lasts.
ex: The length of the room is about six meters.
這間房間的長度約六公尺。

en: A curved piece of glass or plastic used in glasses, cameras and microscopes to make things look larger or clearer.
ex: The photographer changed the lens on his camera.
攝影師換了相機的鏡頭。

en: Willing to accept different opinions and behavior; or giving a lot; or a person who supports political freedom.
ex: My parents have a liberal attitude toward education.
我的父母對教育抱持開明的態度。

en: A cover for a container such as a pot or a box; or the thin skin that covers your eye.
ex: She put the lid back on the jar of jam.
她把果醬罐的蓋子蓋回去。

en: Probably going to happen or be true; or suitable for a particular purpose.
ex: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
今天下午很可能會下雨。

en: The greatest amount or highest level that is allowed; or to keep something within certain amounts.
ex: The speed limit on this road is fifty kilometers per hour.
這條路的速限是每小時五十公里。

en: To join two or more things together; or a connection between things; or a website address that you click.
ex: Click on the link to read the full article.
點擊連結閱讀全文。

en: A substance that flows freely, like water or oil; or in the form of a liquid.
ex: Water is the most common liquid on Earth.
水是地球上最常見的液體。

en: A large organ in your body that cleans your blood; or a person who lives in a particular way or place.
ex: The liver helps the body to remove harmful substances.
肝臟幫助身體排除有害物質。

en: Something heavy that is carried; or the amount of work that someone has to do; or to put things into a vehicle or machine.
ex: She loaded the boxes into the back of the car.
她把箱子裝進車子後面。

en: Relating to a particular area or town; or a person who lives in the area; or not far away.
ex: We bought fresh fruit from a local market.
我們在當地市場買了新鮮水果。

en: Being the only person or thing in a place; or without friends or family; or alone.
ex: A lone tree stood on top of the hill.
一棵孤樹立在山頂。

en: The state of no longer having something, or having less of it; or the death of someone; or a defeat.
ex: The company suffered a heavy loss last year.
這家公司去年蒙受了重大損失。

en: Success or good things that happen to you by chance; or chance in general.
ex: Good luck on your exam tomorrow!
祝你明天考試順利！

en: A weekly or monthly publication with articles and pictures; or a container that holds bullets or film.
ex: She reads a fashion magazine every month.
她每個月都讀一本時尚雜誌。

en: To keep something in good condition; or to continue to have something; or to state firmly that something is true.
ex: It is important to maintain good relations with your neighbors.
與鄰居維持良好的關係很重要。

en: Very large or important; or the main subject that a student studies at university; or to study as a major subject.
ex: She majors in English literature at university.
她在大學主修英國文學。

en: A man or boy; or an animal that can father young; or relating to men.
ex: The male peacock has bright, colorful feathers.
雄孔雀有鮮豔多彩的羽毛。

en: A person in charge of a business, a department or a team; or a person who looks after a sports team.
ex: The manager of the shop is very friendly.
這家店的經理非常和善。

en: A sweet, juicy tropical fruit with yellow-orange flesh and a large seed.
ex: Taiwan is famous for its sweet mangoes in summer.
台灣以夏天的甜芒果聞名。

en: The way in which something is done or happens; or the way someone behaves toward others; or (plural) polite behavior.
ex: He speaks in a calm and friendly manner.
他說話的態度平靜又友善。

en: The legal relationship between a husband and wife; or the ceremony of getting married; or the state of being married.
ex: Their marriage has lasted for over forty years.
他們的婚姻已持續了四十多年。

en: A covering for part or all of your face, used for protection or disguise; or to hide something such as a smell or a feeling.
ex: You must wear a mask when you enter the hospital.
進入醫院時必須戴口罩。

en: A large, solid piece of something; or a large amount; or relating to a large number of people; or a church service.
ex: The factory uses mass production to make cheap shoes.
這家工廠用大量生產的方式製造便宜的鞋子。

en: A small piece of thick material put on a floor; or a piece of material for sitting or lying on; or not shiny.
ex: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before you come in.
進來之前請在墊子上擦一擦鞋。

en: A sports game between two teams or players; or a short wooden stick used to light fires; or to be similar to or go well with something.
ex: Her shoes match her dress perfectly.
她的鞋子和洋裝很搭。

en: A friend or companion; or a person who shares a place such as a flat or a team; or (of animals) to come together to produce young.
ex: My roommate and I share the cost of the rent.
我和室友分攤房租。

en: The matter from which something is made; or cloth; or information used for writing or teaching.
ex: The teacher prepared some teaching materials for the class.
老師為這堂課準備了一些教材。

en: Fully grown or developed; or behaving in a sensible adult way; or (of fruit or cheese) ready to eat.
ex: She is very mature for her age.
她以她的年紀來說非常成熟。

en: What something expresses or represents; or what a word or sign stands for; or the purpose of something.
ex: What is the meaning of this word?
這個字是什麼意思？

en: A way of doing or achieving something; or a method; or money or income.
ex: The bicycle is a cheap means of transport.
腳踏車是便宜的交通工具。

en: To find the size, length or amount of something; or the size or amount of something found by measuring.
ex: She measured the table to see if it would fit in the room.
她測量了那張桌子，看看放不放得進房間。

en: Relating to medicine and the treatment of illness; or a physical examination by a doctor.
ex: He went for a medical examination before starting his new job.
他在開始新工作前去做了健康檢查。
